task.title: Build inline approval UI and split UI modules
task.summary: Add Pi/CodeWiki decision/task approval cards backed by CodeWiki tools while decomposing UI modules enough to keep the approval surface maintainable.

goal.outcome: Users can approve, edit, reject, or defer individual decision rows and task candidates inline while UI ownership stays modular.
acceptance: Pi TUI or compact panel shows pending decision rows with current state, desired state, affected layers, risk, and alternatives.
Inline actions call CodeWiki diff-table actions and leave machine-readable approval evidence before decision_build creation.
Planning task/sprint candidates can be presented for approval before canonical roadmap mutation when the adapter supports the surface; non-interactive fallback remains explicit typed approval.
UI data/read, model, render, and interaction seams are separated enough to avoid further expanding the existing UI manager/control-room monoliths.
Tests cover approve, edit/defer/reject states, build eligibility only for approved rows, fallback behavior, and existing UI smoke behavior.
non_goals: Do not bypass codewiki_diff_table or codewiki_task tools.
Do not remove chat fallback until UI is available in all adapters.
Do not implement agency runner or scheduler logic in UI modules.
verification: control-room and efficiency UI smoke tests
